SLAY_SPOON_LOANS.title: Merchant loans
SLAY_SPOON_LOANS.ask_body: You are {Missing} gold short. Ask the other players for help?
SLAY_SPOON_LOANS.rules: Future gold repays loans. Death does not erase debts. After accepting, buy the item again.
SLAY_SPOON_LOANS.held: Your offer: {Amount} gold held until accepted or withdrawn.
SPOON_SAPPHIRE_SWAP_TIP: Give back {Relic} and undo what it did on pickup. The key counts for the whole team.
